已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
A non-signaling tester is used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode, especially in production where WLAN device RF measurements are done this way to save time; in the R&S Wi‑Fi 7 production context, the R&S CMP180 is positioned as the optimized non-signaling RF measurement tester, while the R&S CMX500 covers R&D signaling / interworking testing [45][5].
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this distinction
| Decision area | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Whether the task is production non-signaling RF testing or R&D signaling testing | The Wi‑Fi 7 test workflow separates R&S CMX500 for R&D signaling / interworking tests and R&S CMP180 for production non-signaling RF tests [5]. |
| Whether to select R&S CMP180 for production RF measurements | In the WLAN device production phase, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and the R&S CMP180 is described as optimized for this purpose [45]. |
| Which CMP180 measurement options to configure | CMP180 measurement options include WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac SISO, 802.11ax SISO, 802.11be SISO, WLAN true MIMO 2x2 and 4x4, WLAN true MIMO 5x5 and 6x6, WLAN packet error rate acknowledgement measurements, LTE measurements, and NR FR1 single-carrier measurements [42]. |
| Whether WLAN PER non-signaling measurement is needed | CMP180 has a WLAN PER nonsignaling measurements option, R&S CMP-KM365 [27]. |
| Whether frequency extension is needed | CMP180 supports many cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, and the R&S CMP-K168 option is defined as extended frequency range from 6 GHz to 8 GHz [45][72]. |
| Whether 500 MHz bandwidth is needed | CMP180 is described as supporting bandwidths up to 500 MHz in the Wi‑Fi 7 production context, and R&S CMP-K185 is the 500 MHz bandwidth option, available only if R&S CMP-B805I or higher is installed [45][71][72]. |
| Whether 2x2 or 4x4 MIMO production testing is needed | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports to support 2x2 MIMO testing in a single box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access points [45]. |
| Whether waveform generation / playback options are part of the production setup | CMP180 supports waveform creator, standard-specific waveform playback and R&S VSE analysis options, and its predefined waveform options include WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax and 802.11be waveform options [43]. |
| Whether to choose CMX500 instead for signaling work | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode and real-world RF TX/RX characteristic measurements, and the R&S CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality [4]. |

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁已依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 記錄 CMX500 的 WLAN signaling / measurement options；本來源補充的是 2024 MWC PR / solution demonstration 語境，不提供正式 option code、software version 或硬體 BOM。
- 既有 [[R&S CMP180]] 頁已依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]] 記錄 8 GHz frequency extension 與 500 MHz bandwidth options；本來源補充 MWC 2024 對 Wi‑Fi 7 production testing 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback demonstration 的 positioning。
- 既有 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 主要來自 Bluetest / EMITE OTA chamber PR；本來源不描述 OTA chamber，而是 R&S own CMX500 / CMP180 single-box R&D / production workflow。
- 既有 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 頁依較晚的 R&S / Broadcom PR 記錄 Wi-Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth；本來源較早期說 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，且 480 MHz waveform 是 potential candidate，因此需在 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 並列而不調和。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

Signaling test solution › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示正式發布日期、作者、整理單位、客戶、專案、版本或適用地區。
- UAV 產品表未提供各產品官方 datasheet、文件版次、通訊模組型號、頻段地區限制、發射功率、頻寬、加密 / 跳頻細節或測試條件。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 5G / Wi‑Fi 配置表未標示依據的正式 configuration guide、軟體版本、license bundle、報價工具版本或 release date。
- 來源寫「配置如有疑問請與 1C PM 確認」，表示表格不應被視為最終報價或完整配置。
- 多技術 De-sense validation 只提供概念與配置合併原則，未提供測試案例、干擾模型、pass / fail limits、setup diagram、synchronization、shielding / chamber 條件或 automation flow。
- `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf` 未擷取正文；不可引用其 anti-jamming 主張。
- `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx` 未擷取正文；不可引用其 5G private network resilience 主張。

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

Signaling test solution › 與既有知識的關係
- [[Communication of UAVs]] 已整理 UAV communication 的功能、鏈路、協定、硬體與頻段摘錄；本來源補充具體 UAV 產品例子與 [[R&S CMX500]] signaling test 配置線索。
- [[Communications on UAVs]] 只是 UAV communication / SDR link hub；本來源比該 link hub 多出可抽取的 CMX500 5G / Wi‑Fi 配置表。
- [[R&S CMX500]]、[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 已有正式產品規格與 features 來源；本來源屬於 Market 類 OneNote solution note，適合用於 UAV use-case / configuration discussion，不應取代正式 specifications 或 configuration tool。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 正式 specifications 已支撐 RF unit 400 MHz to 8000 MHz、CMX500 base unit 1201.0002K70、CMX-PB70H 1222.0676.09、CMX-B200A 1222.0747.02、CMX-B300C 1222.0801.04、CMX-B600B 1222.0953.03、CMX-KM600 1222.4013.02 等資料；本來源與這些資料一致，但用途是 UAV signaling solution 摘要。
- [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 已整理 CMX500 OBT 與 Bluetest 的 4G / 5G NR / WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing；本來源較偏向 conducted / signaling configuration 與多技術 De-sense 驗證概念，未提到 OTA chamber。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Waveform replay
來源描述可 replay any waveform from：

- IQ capture。
- MATLAB。
- Other sources。

流程線索包含：

1. Convert with R&S MATLAB tools from App Note [[1GP60]]。
2. Read in complex IQ vector。
3. Add parameters（sample rate provided in `.info` file in CMX500 captures）。
4. Run conversion script from [[1GP60]]。
5. `.wv` stored in active directory。

CMX500_Callbox › 重點摘要
- Desense / interference 部分描述 WLAN + cellular in one box enables interference / desense testing against all LTE/NR bands with real connections，並列出 WiFi 4096QAM、6 GHz band 320 MHz BW、EN-DC + WiFi7、LTE + NR + WiFi measurements in parallel。
- 3GPP features 部分列出 Rel-15 SUL、Rel-16 UL TX Switching、Rel-17 extensions、Rel-17 PEI、Rel-17 1024 DL QAM、MIMO Nx6/nx8，並宣稱 10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified。
- Multi-SIM 部分描述 DSDS / DSDA：1 DUT、2 SIM slots、2 parallel connections、1 CMX；DSDS 通常 one TX / 2 RX、2 SIMs standby、一次一個 active connection；DSDA 為 two TRX、2 SIMs active connection at a time；option 線索為 [[R&S CMX-KS600B]] NR Signaling SA/NSA 與 [[R&S CMX-KS613B]] Multi-SIM Enabler。
- Callbox example use cases 包含 R&D verification of new bands、sensitivity testing、RedCap、de-sense testing、3GPP pre-conformance、SRS measurements、UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements、UL TX Switching、Multi-SIM、high e2e TP testing 與 non-signaling verification。
- RedCap 部分稱 [[R&S CMX-KS617B]] NR R17 Signaling 用於 RedCap standalone，並列出 early identification via MSG1/MSG3、RedCap initial UL/DL BWP、NCD-SSB、LTE↔NR handover、eDRX、FR1/FR2 supported、Rel. Power Saving、UE measurement relaxation、PEI、PDCCH skipping。
- SRS / UL MIMO / UL TX Switching 部分稱 CMX supports all SRS modes / configurations，SRS measurements 可量測 TX power、EVM 等，[[R&S CMX-KS610B]] 用於 SRS carrier switching；UL MIMO RF measurements 提到 [[R&S CMX-KM604]] NR FR1 measurements MIMO、PC 1.5、29 dBm theoretical sum power for 2 TX antennas、UL FPTX、TX diversity、DFTS-OFDM。
- NTN 部分稱 comprehensive support for NR-NTN，multi-orbit：LEO、MEO、GEO、GSO，complete channel emulation in one box，live graphics for NTN orbits and parameters，NB-NTN coming end of `25，option 線索為 [[R&S CMX-KS627B]] NR Signaling Extension Rel-17。

CMX500_Callbox › 重點摘要
- 來源 frontmatter 顯示原始檔為 `CMX500_Callbox.pptx`，由 markitdown 轉出，converted date 為 2026-09-17；投影片中另出現日期 **05.01.2026**，但日期格式未標示。
- 簡報將測試階段分為 [[Go-NoGo Testing]]、[[Non-Sig Testing]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 與 [[R&D Testing]]，並以 [[R&S CMX500]] callbox 作為可快速建立 call、進行 RF testing、mobility testing 與 application testing 的平台。
- Callbox focus 包含 [[RF Testing]]、[[3GPP pre-conformance]]、[[Mobility Testing]]、[[Application Testing]]、[[Network Slicing]]、[[IP Throughput]]、[[Security Analysis]]、[[Backend Service]]、[[IMS Services]]、[[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]、[[ATSSS]]、[[Power Consumption]]、[[XR Responsiveness & L4S]]、[[eCall]] / [[NGeCall]] 與 [[Speech Quality]]。
- 來源描述 [[CMsquares]] 為 web based、all-in-one configuration、all tools in one place、modern UI 的介面，並列出 live views、app testing、NTN live views、sequencer、log analysis 與 one-click RF testing。
- [[RF SA Preconformance]] 部分宣稱可在 GUI 中快速開始 manual 3GPP RF pre-conformance，並提到 automatic configuration of parameters per TC、25 TCs、dynamic workspace per TC、NR-NTN / NSA / LTE coming、release 時有 comprehensive App Note，連結為 `https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/appnote/1C111`。
- [[CMSequencer]] 部分描述可由 manual 快速切換到 automated pre-conformance，使用 same technology specific license，並引用 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx`；來源圖表列出 RF pre-conformance TC count：category 7.1 為 3GPP 43、7.4 為 68、7.6 為 134、8.3 為 3GPP 159 / RED 33 / WiFi 92。
- R&D automation / RF pathloss calibration 部分描述 predefined blocks、mix & match、PL from signaling measurements + reports、GPRF measurements 與 NRP Power Meter；來源 notes 稱 NRP slightly more precise、GPRF 會包含 connector + additional RF path、golden device 最容易但 least precise。

CMX500_Callbox › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補充 [[R&S CMX500]] 正式 specifications / features 以外的 callbox sales / training 視角；其內容多為 use-case、workflow、roadmap 或 demo claim，不可替代 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 或 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 的 binding specifications。
- 本來源對 [[5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance testing]] 補充 GUI one-click / wizard / 25 TCs / 1C111 app note 的簡報敘事；既有 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 仍是具體 workflow 與限制的主要來源。
- 本來源對 [[CMX500 Sequencer Test Packages]] 補充 manual-to-automated pre-conformance、TC count chart 與 WiFi RF pre-conformance update 的簡報圖表；正式 verified status 仍以 [[Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database]] 為主。
- 本來源對 [[CMX500 NTN one-box tester]] 補充 multi-orbit、complete channel emulation in one box 與 NTN orbit live graphics 的簡報說法；PR 與 configuration guide 仍需分別追溯。
- 本來源對 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]] 補充 application testing 清單中的 WLAN offloading / ATSSS 與 desense / WiFi7 parallel testing 情境。

CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S CMP180]] 屬於 Rohde & Schwarz 的 radio communication tester 產品，與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSV3000]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 signal / spectrum analyzer 類產品不同；本來源主要是無線通訊標準 production / nonsignaling / TX/RX application option 清單與功能概述。
- 本來源是 **Features and Functions**，不是 specifications datasheet；因此所有量測範圍與 tolerance limits 必須回到 **PD 3609.7348.22** 查證。
- WLAN 部分明確把 6 GHz 以上 frequency 使用與 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 **R&S CMP-K168** 連結，320 MHz channel bandwidth 與 **R&S CMP-K185** 連結，True MIMO 第二 connector bench 與 **R&S CMP-K102** / **R&S CMP-K105** 連結。
- [[R&S VSE]] 部分指出 VSE client license 可以由 dongle 或 CMP180 提供；若由 CMP180 提供，需 **R&S CMP-KM150**。

CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 已指出量測範圍與 tolerance limits 不在 Features and Functions 文件內，需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**；本來源正是該 specifications 文件，補足 spec、general data 與 ordering information。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 提到 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 RF unit 分為 **R&S CMP-B802x** 與 **R&S CMP-B805x**，且 **R&S CMP-K185** 可啟用 500 MHz bandwidth；本來源以具體 ordering item **R&S CMP-B802I**、**R&S CMP-B805I**、**R&S CMP-K185** 補足 order number 與 availability 條件。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 提到未安裝 **R&S CMP-K168** 時 maximum 為 6 GHz；本來源在 ordering information 將 **R&S CMP-K168** 定義為 **Extended frequency range, from 6 GHz to 8 GHz**。
- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]] 列出多個 option order number 後綴為 `.xx`；本來源多數對應項目給出 `.02` 或 `.10` / `.11` 版本的完整 order number。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]]、[[R&S CMW500]]、[[R&S CMW290]]、[[R&S CMW270]] 同屬 Rohde & Schwarz wireless / radio communication test 產品知識區，但 [[R&S CMP180]] 的本文件聚焦 production tester 類 RF generator/analyzer 規格與多埠 RF 測試。

CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00 › RF generator / analyzer 功能
General functions：

- simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing。
- RF generator/analyzer no. 1：**8 × SnapN**，RF input/output to DUT，RF 1.1 to RF 1.8。
- RF generator/analyzer no. 2：**8 × SnapN**，RF input/output to DUT，RF 2.1 to RF 2.8；requires **R&S CMP-K102** or **R&S CMP-K105** software license key。

Receiver test functions：

- RF generator signal is split and forwarded to 8 output ports each。
- every output can be switched off separately。
- collective output level setting for RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 and RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）table for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

Transmitter test functions：

- 8 input signals multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1。
- 8 input signals multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）tables for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

VSWR：

| Port | Frequency | 規格 |

### Short answer
A non-signaling tester is used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode, especially in production where WLAN device RF measurements are done this way to save time; in the R&S Wi‑Fi 7 production context, the R&S CMP180 is positioned as the optimized non-signaling RF measurement tester, while the R&S CMX500 covers R&D signaling / interworking testing [45][5].
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this distinction
| Decision area | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| Whether the task is production non-signaling RF testing or R&D signaling testing | The Wi‑Fi 7 test workflow separates R&S CMX500 for R&D signaling / interworking tests and R&S CMP180 for production non-signaling RF tests [5]. |
| Whether to select R&S CMP180 for production RF measurements | In the WLAN device production phase, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and the R&S CMP180 is described as optimized for this purpose [45]. |
| Which CMP180 measurement options to configure | CMP180 measurement options include WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac SISO, 802.11ax SISO, 802.11be SISO, WLAN true MIMO 2x2 and 4x4, WLAN true MIMO 5x5 and 6x6, WLAN packet error rate acknowledgement measurements, LTE measurements, and NR FR1 single-carrier measurements [42]. |
| Whether WLAN PER non-signaling measurement is needed | CMP180 has a WLAN PER nonsignaling measurements option, R&S CMP-KM365 [27]. |
| Whether frequency extension is needed | CMP180 supports many cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, and the R&S CMP-K168 option is defined as extended frequency range from 6 GHz to 8 GHz [45][72]. |
| Whether 500 MHz bandwidth is needed | CMP180 is described as supporting bandwidths up to 500 MHz in the Wi‑Fi 7 production context, and R&S CMP-K185 is the 500 MHz bandwidth option, available only if R&S CMP-B805I or higher is installed [45][71][72]. |
| Whether 2x2 or 4x4 MIMO production testing is needed | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports to support 2x2 MIMO testing in a single box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access points [45]. |
| Whether waveform generation / playback options are part of the production setup | CMP180 supports waveform creator, standard-specific waveform playback and R&S VSE analysis options, and its predefined waveform options include WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax and 802.11be waveform options [43]. |
| Whether to choose CMX500 instead for signaling work | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing requires signaling mode and real-world RF TX/RX characteristic measurements, and the R&S CMX500 is described as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality [4]. |
